spans.s:
mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
1 Near, proximate.
2 Kinless, solitary.
E.
नि, and कटच् affix; or नि prefixed to कट to go to or towards, affix अच्.

m. (-रः)
1 A flock or multitude.
2 A heap, a bundle.
3 Pith, sap, essence.
4 Suitable or proper gift.
5 A treasure, especially belonging to KUVERA: see निधि.
E.
नि in or upon, कृ to throw, affix अप्.

m. (-रः)
1 Opposition, contradiction.
2 Injury, wrong, offence.
3 Wickedness; malice.
4 Abuse, reproach, disrespect.
5 Raising, tossing or lifting up.
6 Piling or winnowing corn.
E.
नि depreciative prefix, कृ to make, or कॄ to throw, affix घञ् or अप्.

m. (-रः)
Disrespect, contempt, vilifying, degrading.
E.
नि before कृ to make, aff. अण्.

m. (-णः)
1 An open space or sort of play-ground in or near a town.
2 A court at the entrance to a house.
3 A neighbourhood.
E.
नि, with कर्षण ploughing; so prepared.

m. (-षः)
The touch-stone.
f. (-षा)
The mother of the imps or goblins.
E.
नि prefixed to कष to injure, affix घ.

ind.
1 Near, proximate.
2 In the middle, betwixt, between.
E.
नि prefixed to कष to hurt, Uṇādi affix आ.

m. (-सः)
A touch-stone: see निकष.

m. (-षः)
Rubbing.
E.
नि before कष to hurt, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Like, (in composition): see नीकास.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
(In composition,) Like, resembling.
m. (-शः)
Certainty, ascertainment.
E.
नि before काश to shine, aff. घञ्, and the vowel made long.

m. (-जः)
A Rākṣasa, a sort of goblin.
E.
निकषा the mother of the race, and आत्मज a son.

n. adv. (-मं)
Voluntarily, willingly, implying certainty.
E.
नि, काम will.

m. (-यः)
1 An assemblage of persons performing like duties, a congregation, an audience.
2 A flock, a multitude.
3 A butt, a mark.
4 A house, a habitation.
5 The Supreme Being.
E.
नि in or within, चि to collect, affix घञ्, and क substituted for the radical initial.

m. (-य्यः)
A house.
E.
as above: see निकाय, deriv. irr.

n. (-णं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
नि prefixed to कॄ to injure, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-कः)
A measure of capacity equal to (1/4th) of a Kuḍava.
E.
नि before कुचि to be small, affix क्वुन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Contracted.
E.
नि in, and कुञ्चित curved.

mn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जं)
An arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with creepers.
E.
नि expletive, and कुञ्ज an arbour.

m. (-म्भः)
1 The son of KUMBHAKARṆA, the brother of RĀVAṆ

A plant, (Croton polyandrum.)
E.
कु the earth भू to be, affix खच्, and नि prefixed.

f. (-ला)
A place where offerings with fire are made.
E.
नि before कुम्भ a jar, इलच् aff.

n. (-म्बं)
A flock or multitude; also निकुरुम्बक.
E.
नि before कुर to divide or cut, affix अम्बच्, and उ substituted for the penultimate; also read निकुरुम्भ.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dishonest, wicked, perverse.
2 Removed, set aside, dismissed.
3 Tricked, cheated, deceived.
4 Injured, afflicted.
5 Low, base, vile.
E.
नि prefixed to कृत to cut, affix क.

f. (-तिः)
1 Wickedness, dishonesty.
2 Abuse, reproach.
3 Rejection, removal.
4 Poverty, indigence.
E.
नि prefixed to कृत to cut, affix कि.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Outcast, despised, low, vile.
E.
नि prefixed to कृष to make furrows, to revile or despise, affix क्त.

m. (-यः)
Piling or collecting repeatedly.
E.
नि before चि to gather, reit. v., घञ् aff.

m. (-तः)
A house, a habitation.
E.
नि in, कित to dwell, affix घञ्; also with युच् affix निकेतन.

n. (-कं)
A house, a dwelling.
E.
कन् added to निकेत.

n. (-नं)
A house, a habitation.
m. (-नः)
An onion.
E.
see निकेत.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.)
E.
नि prefixed to कुच to be crooked, affix वुन्; also derived from कुठ to surround, निकोठक; also with अण् pleonasm added, निकौचक.

m. (-णः)
1 A musical tone or sound.
2 Any sound.
E.
नि prefixed to क्वण to sound, अप् affix; also with घञ् affix निक्वाण m. (-णः.)

r. 1st cl. (निक्षति)
To kiss: see णिक्ष.

f. (-क्षा)
A nit.
E.
णिश to meditate, Uṇādi affix स.

n. (-णं)
Kissing.
E.
निक्ष to kiss, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Rejected, abandoned, foregone, given or thrown away.
2 Deposited, pawned, pledged.
3 Thrust into, placed in.
4 Sent, sent off or away.
E.
नि implying absolutely or internally, and क्षिप्त thrown away, &c.

mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्)
Throwing or placing in or upon.
E.
नि before क्षिप to throw, affix शतृ.

m. (-पः)
1 A pledge, a deposit in general, or one which is counted or particularised in presence of the receiver, and left without cover or seal.
2 Abandoning, parting with, throwing away.
3 Sending or putting away.
4 Wiping, drying.
E.
नि prefixed to क्षिप to throw or reject, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-प्ता-प्त्री-प्तृ)
Who or what places or deposites.
m. (-प्ता)
A depositor, a pawner or pledger.
E.
नि before क्षिष to throw, तृच् aff.

m. (-कः)
The name of a tree.
E.
णी to gain, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
